INSERT INTO error_injection.config (
                endpoint_pattern,
                http_method,
                error_rate,
                error_code,
                error_message,
                latency_ms
            )
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)
            RETURNING
                id,
                endpoint_pattern,
                http_method,
                error_rate,
                error_code,
                error_message,
                latency_ms
